title: The census of numbered runs of a book (mcprep exercises census --json and --details)
description: Every run of numbered items in the text layer of the whole book (five or more items numbered one after the other: an exercise set, an answer key, a list of references, the steps of a method) and whether the project covers it. It needs no heading word and no layout. The file written by --details has every item of every run (`items`); the --json result of the command has the same report with the items left out of each run (`itemsOutside`, the number of its items outside every region, in their place) and `listed` (how many runs `runs` holds: with --uncovered only the ones the project does not cover). Pages are zero-based; rectangles are fractions of the page, top left is (0, 0). Plain JSON, camelCase.

minRun.description: The fewest items a run has (--min-run, default 5).

listed.description: Only in the --json result: the number of runs in `runs`.

runs.description: Runs found (all of them, also when --uncovered lists only some).

pagesWithRuns.description: Pages that hold an item of some run.

covered.description: Runs that the project covers: at least 80 percent of their items lie inside a region (an exercise, a continuation, an instruction or an answer).

itemsOutside.description: Items outside every region, in all runs.

leftOut.description: The length of `leftOut`: candidates of five or more numbered items that were set aside.

id.description: `p32:8`: the zero-based page of the first item and its first label (`8`; `8_paren` for the label `8)` and `8_parens` for `(8)`, so that no shell takes it for syntax; `1.12`; `Exercise_4.2` for a keyword label); a second run with the same id gets `#2`. The gate gives the finding numbered-run-uncovered this id as its ref.

pages.description: The pages that hold items, in order.

missing.description: How many numbers between the first and the last have no item (the text layer drops lines, books skip numbers): at most one in ten.

scheme.description: How the items are labelled: `8.`, `8)`, `(8)`, a dotted label of one chapter (`4.12`: the last number rises), a keyword and a number.

step.description: 1 for consecutive numbers, 2 for a key that prints only every second one.

parity.description: With step 2: whether the numbers are odd or even.

keyword.description: The word of a keyword label as printed (`Exercise`, `Aufgabe`).

heading.description: The nearest line above the first item that is no item and is set larger or bolder than the text, else the nearest short line; only reported, no heading word decides anything.

start.description: The first 60 characters of the first item.

coverage.description: The share of the items that lie inside a region of the project (at least half of the line).

itemsOutside.description: Only in the --json result: the number of items outside every region (the items themselves are in the --details file).

items.description: Only in the --details file: every item of the run, in reading order.

rect.description: The box of the line that starts the item (one cell of a row of several).

n.description: The number the item counts as (the last number of a dotted label).

text.description: The first 60 characters of the line.

covered.description: The line lies inside a region of the project.

leftOut.description: The candidates that were set aside, in reading order, each with its reason: nothing the census leaves out is silent.

reason.description: years: all the numbers are years. contents: a table of contents, an index or a list with leader dots (the lines end in page numbers or have leaders). running-head: a line in the top or bottom band of three or more pages, about one to a page. short-items: fewer than ten items of one or two characters (a column of values, the cells of a table). headings: the headings of the book printed again as a list (the outline of a chapter before its sections).

coverage.description: The share of its items that lie inside a region of the project (a candidate the project covers anyway is no loss).
